methodology.airportJoin: Match existing airport ICAO/FAA identifier to APT_BASE, then join APT runway records by ARPT_ID, SITE_NO and SITE_TYPE_CODE. Join FRQ by SERVICED_FACILITY, AIRPORT site type, country and state; provider FACILITY can differ. Weather frequencies use a matched AWOS station ID/type associated to the same airport SITE_NO.
methodology.runways: Only paired designators with positive physical length and width appear in runways. Helipads are separate. The zero-length SNA 20X procedure placeholder is omitted.
methodology.runwayHeading: trueHeadingDeg is the FAA TRUE_ALIGNMENT published integer degree; missing stays null. derivedTrueHeadingDeg is a separate calculated initial great-circle bearing from published runway end coordinates, rounded to 0.1 degree, only when published heading is missing.
methodology.runwayStatus: runwayStatus is null: these CSV fields do not provide current runway operational status. Airport status is a cycle snapshot. Surface condition is a published physical condition, not current braking action. Read operational remarks, current Chart Supplement and NOTAMs.
methodology.trafficPattern: rightTraffic is the published Y/N flag. trafficPattern translates Y to right, N to left, missing to null. Published TPA is feet AGL; airport-specific remarks may define different aircraft/runway altitudes.
methodology.communications: VHF 118.000 through 136.999 MHz only; CTAF, UNICOM, local/tower, ground, clearance, ATIS, ASOS/AWOS, approach/departure, Class B/C and TRSA records retained. Numeric frequency formatted to 3 decimal places. Original use, sectorization and remarks preserved. Not a complete radio/navigation directory.
methodology.frequencyPrimary: primary flag decodes /P and /S in published use; null for other uses. Preserve runway/sector restrictions and local tower hours.
methodology.magneticVariation: Published magnetic variation epoch is retained and can be old. Do not use it as current geomagnetic declination or subtract it from METAR wind when using true runway headings.
methodology.wind: AWC METAR winds are from true north. Tower and ATIS/ASOS/AWOS voice wind directions are magnetic. Compare METAR wind to runway trueHeadingDeg directly.
methodology.pressureAltitudeEstimate: PA_ft = elevation_ft + (29.92 - altimeter_inHg) * 1000; approximate. Altimeter setting is not station pressure.
methodology.densityAltitudeEstimate: ISA_C = 15 - 0.0019812 * PA_ft; DA_ft = PA_ft + 120 * (OAT_C - ISA_C). This is an approximation that excludes humidity and is not aircraft performance data.
methodology.formulaAttribution: FAA AIM supports the approximate 1000 ft/inHg relationship. The 120 ft/degree C approximation is published in Air Force meteorological training hosted by NWS, not attributed here as an exact FAA formula.
